Chris.name: Chris
notes: Chris Comerford, 20, omega, son of Marquis Comerford; past-life memories of Kaoru Kusakabe, 28, pharmacist. Married to King Allen as consort; fakes being a 'defective omega' with self-made inhibitors to avoid the novel's death route.
Ch.19: confesses he faked being a defective omega with inhibitors, tells Allen he loves him and wants his child.

Allen.name: Allen
notes: Allen Zilfonia, 22, alpha, King of Zilfonia. Cold to Chris; first husband Nathaniel.
Since ch.2 openly affectionate toward Chris; had a nightmare calling for his omega parent ('Dad, don't leave me') -- possibly abandoned as a child.
Ch.14: gave Chris a wedding band; refuses to take Noah or any other consort -- minister Calvin seems in league with Prince Julian to make Zilfonia Orvent's vassal.

Ch.15: Calvin reveals Allen is not the late king's son -- the real heir was stillborn and a newborn of the Mulligan house (Nate Mulligan) was swapped in on the late king's order. Allen flees to an old Comerford manor.
Ch.16: as a child his omega father rejected him as 'not my son, an impostor', was thought mad, and took his own life; Allen decides to retake the throne to protect the people.
Ch.19: wins the war, publicly reveals he is Nate Mulligan without royal blood, and the people acclaim him king again; makes Chris his official husband.

Nathaniel.name: Nathaniel
notes: Allen's official spouse (chính phu), strikingly beautiful, long hair; lives in the Red Rose Palace; outwardly gracious, privately resentful of Chris.
Ch.17: his family (Marquis Abernathy) sides with Calvin; he stays with Allen's side, expects to be demoted and Chris made official husband; married Allen only for politics and is relieved.

Colin.name: Colin
notes: Colin Mulligan, eldest son of Marquis Mulligan (one of the three great marquis houses), Allen's classmate, recently found to be an omega; the only noble who treated the old Chris as an equal. Engaged to a son-in-law partner in ch.6.

Ted.name: Ted
notes: Ted Comerford, Chris's younger brother (two years younger), just graduated from the Noble's Academy; calls Chris 'anh hai'; cool toward Allen because he only knew Allen's coldness to the old Chris.

Chris's papa.name: Chris's papa
notes: Chris's omega parent, Marquis Comerford's husband ('Marchioness'); Chris calls him 'ba' (the Marquis is 'cha').

Noah.name: Noah
notes: Noah, Second Prince of Orvent, red-haired omega, cheerful and innocent; rumoured candidate to become Allen's second consort.
Ch.18: turns against his brother Julian's plot, arrives with troops and holds the Orvent army so Allen can reach the capital; believes all nations should be equal.

Julian.name: Julian
notes: Julian, First Prince of Orvent, red hair, glasses, about Allen's age, soon to be crowned; courteous, protective.
Ch.17: Calvin reports to him in Orvent's capital; privately despises Calvin ('you pig').

Calvin.name: Calvin
notes: Calvin, Zilfonia's Minister of Foreign Affairs, former Orvent merchant; proposed Noah as Allen's second consort.
Ch.15: stages a coup; plans to crown a beta descendant of the former King Jack, with Prince Noah as official husband.

Marquis Mulligan.name: Marquis Mulligan
notes: Allen's birth father (Allen was born Nate Mulligan and swapped in as the late king's heir); joins Allen's march; Allen asks to call him father once the war is won.
